title: Super Mario Odyssey
description:
Super Mario Odyssey is a large, globe-trotting 3D action-platforming adventure developed and published by Nintendo. Mario leaves the Mushroom Kingdom and teams up with Cappy, a sentient Bonneter who takes the form of Mario's red cap. Together they pursue Bowser, who has kidnapped Princess Peach and is travelling across the world collecting everything he needs for an extravagant wedding.

The game's central progression system revolves around Power Moons. Mario explores expansive Kingdoms and completes platforming challenges, puzzles, races, hidden-room trials, boss encounters and environmental discoveries to earn Moons. These power the Odyssey, Mario and Cappy's hat-shaped airship, unlocking the route to further Kingdoms.

Cappy transforms Mario's traditional moveset. Mario can throw Cappy straight, upward, downward or in a spin, use him as a temporary platform, and Capture many enemies, creatures and objects. Captures radically alter movement and interaction: a Goomba can stack with other Goombas, a Bullet Bill can fly through gaps, a Sherm provides tank-style firepower, a Cheep Cheep can remain underwater, a Lava Bubble can travel through lava, and a T-Rex provides enormous destructive strength.

The adventure uses a sandbox-style structure inspired by the exploration-driven lineage of Super Mario 64 and Super Mario Sunshine. Kingdoms are densely packed rather than purely linear, rewarding experimentation and curiosity. Regional purple coins can be spent on Kingdom-specific souvenirs and outfits, while regular coins buy additional clothing and items at Crazy Cap stores.

The game includes a two-player cooperative mode in which Player 1 controls Mario and Player 2 independently controls Cappy. Assist Mode adds guidance arrows, extra health, health regeneration and gentler recovery after falling, making the adventure accessible to newer players without removing the standard mode.

Post-game content is extensive. Additional Power Moons, costumes and harder challenges become available, and later destinations include challenging end-game areas. The free Balloon World update adds Luigi's network-enabled Hide It and Find It challenge, while Nintendo Labo VR support adds selected VR-compatible experiences.

On Nintendo Switch 2, a free update significantly enhances the original Nintendo Switch release. Nintendo officially added improved visuals optimized for the Switch 2 display and high-resolution TVs, HDR support, and GameShare. Two people can share the co-op experience locally or through GameChat, with one controlling Mario and the other Cappy.

The current official software version at the time of this file is Ver. 1.4.1.

description_short: A globe-trotting 3D Mario sandbox adventure in which Mario teams up with Cappy, captures enemies and objects, collects Power Moons, explores diverse Kingdoms, and receives free visual, HDR and GameShare enhancements on Nintendo Switch 2.
description_ar:
Super Mario Odyssey هي مغامرة أكشن ومنصات ثلاثية الأبعاد بأسلوب Sandbox من Nintendo، وتُعد واحدة من أهم ألعاب Mario الحديثة. يغادر Mario مملكة الفطر وينطلق في رحلة حول العالم بصحبة Cappy، وهو كائن من شعب Bonneters يتخذ شكل قبعة Mario الحمراء.

تبدأ المطاردة بعد أن يخطف Bowser الأميرة Peach ويقرر إقامة حفل زفاف ضخم معها. أثناء سفره بين الممالك يجمع Bowser مستلزمات الحفل، بينما يحاول Mario وCappy اللحاق به وإفساد خطته.

تعتمد رحلة التقدم على Power Moons. يستكشف اللاعب كل Kingdom ويجد الأقمار عبر تحديات منصات، ألغاز، سباقات، أسرار، غرف مخفية، مواجهات زعماء ومهمات صغيرة. تعمل Power Moons كوقود لسفينة Odyssey وتفتح الطريق إلى ممالك جديدة.

الميزة التي تغير أسلوب اللعب هي Cappy. يستطيع Mario رمي القبعة في عدة اتجاهات، استخدامها لضرب الأعداء وتشغيل المفاتيح، أو القفز عليها للوصول لمسافات أبعد. الأهم هو Capture: يمكن السيطرة على عدد كبير من الأعداء والمخلوقات والأجسام والاستفادة من قدراتها الخاصة.

من أمثلة الـCaptures التي تعرضها Nintendo رسمياً: Goomba لتكوين أبراج Goomba، Bullet Bill للطيران، Sherm لاستخدام المدفع، Hammer Bro لرمي المطارق، Moe-Eye لرؤية الأشياء المخفية، Chain Chomp لتحطيم العوائق، Uproot للوصول عمودياً، T-Rex للقوة التدميرية، Lava Bubble للتحرك في الحمم، وCheep Cheep للسباحة تحت الماء دون الحاجة للعودة إلى السطح.

الممالك واسعة ومليئة بالمقتنيات وليست مجرد مراحل خطية. يمكن العثور على Regional Coins البنفسجية الخاصة بكل مملكة واستخدامها لشراء أزياء وهدايا تذكارية من Crazy Cap، كما توجد مجموعة كبيرة من الملابس والأزياء التي يستمر فتحها أثناء التقدم وبعد نهاية القصة.

تدعم اللعبة Co-op لشخصين؛ اللاعب الأول يتحكم بـMario والثاني يتحكم بـCappy بصورة مستقلة. كما يوجد Assist Mode الذي يوفر أسهماً للإرشاد، صحة أكبر، استرجاع الصحة عند الوقوف واستعادة أسهل بعد السقوط.

بعد إنهاء القصة يستمر المحتوى بشكل كبير عبر المزيد من Power Moons والتحديات والأزياء والمناطق الصعبة. تحديث Balloon World المجاني أضاف Luigi's Balloon World بنمطي Hide It وFind It، بينما أضاف تحديث لاحق دعماً لـNintendo Labo Toy-Con VR Goggles وتجارب VR محددة.

في 2025 حصلت اللعبة على تحديث مجاني مخصص للاستفادة من Nintendo Switch 2. Nintendo تؤكد أن الصورة أصبحت محسنة لشاشة Switch 2 وأجهزة التلفاز عالية الدقة، مع دعم HDR وGameShare. ويمكن لشخصين اللعب معاً باستخدام نسخة واحدة في الإعدادات المدعومة، محلياً أو عبر GameChat، بحيث يتحكم أحدهما بـMario والآخر بـCappy.

آخر إصدار رسمي عند إعداد هذا الملف هو Ver. 1.4.1.

nintendoNotes:
Nintendo officially confirms Super Mario Odyssey as Nintendo Switch software playable on Nintendo Switch 2. The free Ver. 1.4.0 update adds Switch 2-optimized visuals, HDR and GameShare; it is not a separately sold Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

Current Nintendo regional listings differ in language metadata. Nintendo Europe lists Japanese, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch and Russian, while Nintendo Malaysia's official product information also lists Portuguese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Ver. 1.1.0 officially added Korean support. The file therefore records the global regional language set and explicitly notes regional variation.

Nintendo eShop AU NSUID: 70010000000127. The base physical product code is HAC-P-AAACA. The standard physical release is a conventional Nintendo Switch game card, not a Game-Key Card.

Latest version: Ver. 1.4.1, released 24 June 2025 in Nintendo of America / 25 June in Nintendo Europe. Ver. 1.4.0 was released 3 June 2025 ahead of Switch 2 launch and introduced the Switch 2 enhancements.

Nintendo officially confirms 1–2 same-system players, amiibo, surround sound, Save Data Cloud, TV/Tabletop/Handheld play and Nintendo Labo compatibility. Online functionality includes Luigi's Balloon World; Switch 2 also supports GameShare locally or via GameChat.

worldSummary:
Super Mario Odyssey is structured as a globe-spanning trip through Kingdoms rather than one seamless open world. The Odyssey airship serves as the transport hub, and Power Moons provide the energy required to travel farther.

The adventure includes:
1. Cap Kingdom — Bonneton
2. Cascade Kingdom — Fossil Falls
3. Sand Kingdom — Tostarena
4. Lake Kingdom — Lake Lamode
5. Wooded Kingdom — Steam Gardens
6. Cloud Kingdom — Nimbus Arena
7. Lost Kingdom — Forgotten Isle
8. Metro Kingdom — New Donk City
9. Snow Kingdom — Shiveria
10. Seaside Kingdom — Bubblaine
11. Luncheon Kingdom — Mount Volbono
12. Ruined Kingdom — Crumbleden
13. Bowser's Kingdom
14. Moon Kingdom
15. Mushroom Kingdom — post-game return to a classic Mario setting
16. Dark Side — post-game challenge area
17. Darker Side — high-difficulty post-game challenge

The Kingdoms deliberately contrast with one another. Nintendo's official travel-guide material highlights locations ranging from ancient ruins and deserts to dense forests, neon-lit New Donk City, frozen Shiveria, an ocean resort filled with Sparkle Water, a volcanic food culture and the Moon itself.

Regional Coins are unique to each Kingdom and buy location-specific outfits and souvenirs. The world contains standard platforming, Capture-based traversal, secret rooms, 2D retro sections, bosses, races, minigames and environmental puzzles.

perfNotes:
Nintendo officially states that Ver. 1.4.0 optimizes visuals for the Nintendo Switch 2 display and high-resolution TVs and adds HDR, but Nintendo does not publish exact native-resolution values.

Independent technical analysis reports the Switch 2 version reaching a dynamic output of roughly 1800p in TV mode, 1080p in handheld mode and an essentially locked 60 FPS target. The original Switch version used lower dynamic resolutions while also targeting 60 FPS. These exact numbers are third-party technical observations, not Nintendo-published specifications.
storageNotes:
Nintendo AU eShop currently lists Required Space as 5.6 GB on both Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. Nintendo's current US product metadata has shown approximately 5.7 GB for the Nintendo Switch 2 version after updates, so minor regional/storefront differences can occur.

Extra free space is required for update data. Ver. 1.4.0 and Ver. 1.4.1 are separate update data layered on top of the base game.

A microSD card is optional when sufficient system storage is available. Original Nintendo Switch supports standard compatible microSD cards; Nintendo Switch 2 uses microSD Express cards for expanded Switch 2 storage.

faq.q: Does Super Mario Odyssey run on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. It is an original Nintendo Switch game that runs on Switch 2 and receives free Switch 2-specific visual, HDR and GameShare enhancements.
Up to two players on one system, with Player 1 controlling Mario and Player 2 controlling Cappy.

faq.q: Does the game have paid DLC?
faq.a: No paid expansion was released; Balloon World, Nintendo Labo VR support and Switch 2 enhancements were delivered through free updates.

verdictSummary:
Super Mario Odyssey remains one of Nintendo's strongest 3D platformers. Cappy and the Capture system dramatically expand Mario's movement options without making the core controls difficult to learn, while the Kingdom structure rewards experimentation and exploration at nearly every turn.

The main campaign is approachable, but collecting more Power Moons and clearing the post-game opens considerably harder platforming challenges. The amount of optional content is one of the game's greatest strengths, although players who prefer more linear Mario design may find the density of simple collectible Moons excessive.

The free Nintendo Switch 2 update improves the current version further through better image quality, HDR and GameShare without requiring a paid upgrade.
verdictPros: Exceptional movement system built around Mario's traditional controls, Cappy and Capture.
Creative Kingdom design with dense secrets, collectibles and varied challenges.
Substantial post-game content plus free Nintendo Switch 2 visual, HDR and GameShare improvements.
verdictCons: Some Power Moons are extremely simple, reducing the sense of importance of individual collectibles.
A small number of optional actions rely on motion controls.
The two-player mode is asymmetrical because the second player controls Cappy rather than a full independent character.

studioAbout:
Super Mario Odyssey was developed by Nintendo's internal 3D Mario development group within Nintendo Entertainment Planning & Development (Nintendo EPD), with development assistance from 1-UP Studio.

Key staff associated with the project include:
- Kenta Motokura — Director of Super Mario Odyssey. Nintendo later confirmed he continued as a central leader in the same 3D-action development lineage.
- Yoshiaki Koizumi — Producer.
- Koichi Hayashida — Producer; Nintendo's later Ask the Developer material confirms his producer role on Super Mario Odyssey.
- Wataru Tanaka — implemented player controls and directed the core system of action elements in Super Mario Odyssey, according to Nintendo's 2025 Ask the Developer interview for Donkey Kong Bananza.
- Naoto Kubo — led overall sound development for Super Mario Odyssey.
- Shiho Fujii and Koji Kondo were among the major composers associated with the score.

The project returned 3D Mario to a more open sandbox-style exploration structure after the comparatively linear 3D Land / 3D World design approach.

Capture and Cappy were built around the idea of giving Mario a broad set of contextual abilities without permanently bloating his standard moveset. Different enemies and objects effectively become temporary playable toolsets.

Nintendo's later Donkey Kong Bananza development interview also revealed that voxel technology was experimented with during Super Mario Odyssey, though its use was limited at that stage. That technical experimentation later informed Bananza's destruction system.

The free Nintendo Switch 2 enhancement is software-update content for the existing game rather than a separately sold Switch 2 Edition.

Nintendo Switch Online is required for applicable online functions and Save Data Cloud, not for the main single-player adventure.
